title: Enterprise Account Manager
description:
Correlation One is the largest provider of AI and data workforce development programs globally, having trained over 500,000 professionals across 11 countries. As the largest training provider for Amazon Career Choice and a growing partner to state governments building registered apprenticeship programs, Correlation One sits at the intersection of employer talent needs and scalable workforce training.

We work with Fortune 500 enterprises, federal and state government agencies, and leading employers to close skills gaps in AI, data analytics, cybersecurity, and operations leadership. Our programs produce job-ready graduates who are prepared to contribute from day one.

Your impact

As an Enterprise Account Manager, you will support a portfolio of enterprise client relationships and help ensure clients see measurable business impact from their AI workforce development programs. You will work closely with the client's stakeholders and Correlation One's internal teams to keep programs on track, resolve issues before they escalate, and identify opportunities for the partnership to grow.

This is an execution-focused relationship role, typically supporting a Director of Client Partnerships on a defined set of accounts or workstreams. You will build strong day-to-day relationships with client program owners and sponsors, help maintain account plans, and translate client needs into clear action for internal teams.

You will help carry client outcomes from plan to delivery. That includes tracking program milestones, flagging risks early, keeping stakeholders informed, and contributing ideas on where Correlation One can expand the relationship through additional programs, services, or pilots.

This role is ideal for someone who is a strong relationship manager, a clear communicator, and a reliable cross-functional operator who is ready to grow into broader account ownership.

A day in the life

• Build and maintain relationships with client program owners and day-to-day stakeholders, supporting the broader executive relationship map led by the Director.

• Help maintain account plans that connect client priorities, program delivery, and renewal health.

• Coordinate with cross-functional teams across learning, program operations, product, marketing, analytics, and sales to keep client commitments on track.

• Monitor delivery and adoption milestones, flag risks early, and help drive internal follow-through before issues become client escalations.

• Support client check-ins and business reviews, helping translate program data and client feedback into clear next steps.

• Help identify renewal and expansion signals, and bring them to the Director and account leadership for strategy development.

• Maintain account documentation, including stakeholder maps, meeting notes, and status trackers, using established account-management templates.

• Track and report on key metrics: program quality, learner adoption, stakeholder engagement, and delivery status.

• Partner with Sales and Growth teams on renewal logistics and SOW coordination as needed.

Your expertise

• 5 to 7 years of experience in account management, client success, consulting, or program delivery, ideally in a client-facing capacity with U.S.-based enterprises

• Demonstrated ability to manage day-to-day client relationships and keep complex workstreams moving.

• Strong relationship-building skills with client stakeholders at multiple levels.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn program details into concise updates and next steps.

• Ability to coordinate across internal teams and keep people aligned on deliverables.

• Good judgment in prioritizing tasks, managing ambiguity, and knowing when to escalate.

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach to spotting and surfacing expansion or renewal opportunities.

• Experience and interest in workforce development, digital transformation, education, Artificial Intelligence, or technology sectors

Job Summary
Aptive is seeking a full-time Technical Writer to support the Federal Highway Administration’s (FHWA) Office of Research, Development, and Technology (RD&T) at the Turner-Fairbank Highway Research Center (TFHRC). WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

THE ROLE

As Imprint's Senior Engineering Manager for Security, you will report to the Director of Engineering for Trust & Security. You will own the entire security engineering foundation. This includes AI security governance, application security, cloud infrastructure, detection and response, and identity management. You'll build this with AI leverage from day one, scaling a small team's impact with modern tooling.

Imprint is deliberately small and talent-dense. We use AI and tooling to give every person outsized leverage. This is a role where you can stay hands-on for as long as it makes sense. - Full-Stack Ownership: Own the entire security domain: application security, cloud infrastructure, detection engineering, and AI governance.

- Preventative, Not Reactive: Build security that scales with the business rather than firefighting inherited problems. Do it right from the start, before bad patterns harden.

- Series D Sweet Spot: We have product-market fit and real traction, but we're still small enough for you to shape everything. Your decisions will drive our security posture for years to come.

- High-Trust Domain: Co-branded credit cards in regulated fintech (PCI, SOC 2, ISO). Security isn't a tax here; it's what enables every partner launch and every customer interaction.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- AI security: threat-model Imprint's agent surfaces for prompt injection, tool misuse, and authorization boundaries.

- AI for security: build AI-native capabilities that scale a small team's impact: AI-powered detection triage, automated compliance evidence collection, and threat-m

title: Synthetic Population Engineer
description:
The Synthetic Population Engineer uses cutting edge data science techniques to continuously improve the Epistemix synthetic population. A synthetic population is a statistically representative model of a population of real people and their environment, including personal attributes, social connections, and associations between people and places. These datasets empower customers to solve problems in domains where empirical data is unavailable due to legitimate concerns for personal privacy or where desired data simply does not exist. The Synthetic Population Engineer contributes to profitable growth by making the synthetic population more useful and accessible to customers, increasing adoption and utilization. Having a synthetic population that is continuously updated and improved over time is critical to building trust in the models and solutions built with our platform.
About Epistemix
The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.
We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. description:

A Pessoa Supervisora de Data Strategy atuará como líder analítico e estratégico de uma torre dedicada às categorias de Perfumaria, Beauty e Datas Sazonais .

Trata-se de um perfil híbrido e de alta autonomia, com forte capacidade de conectar diferentes ecossistemas de dados (mídia, conversação em redes, PR, indicadores de negócio e receita). O profissional participará ativamente desde o planejamento das campanhas, definindo metodologias e estruturas de mensuração, até a entrega de avaliações de pós-venda transversais e orientadas a aprendizados de negócio, liderando uma equipe de especialistas e reportando diretamente ao Gerente de Research.

O que esperamos:

• Referência na Torre de Categorias: Imergir profundamente no universo de Perfumaria, Beauty e grandes momentos sazonais, sendo a referência analítica para entender as dinâmicas, comportamentos e contextos dessas categorias.

• Pós-Venda Transversal: Unir e liderar os times analíticos no fechamento das campanhas, garantindo a entrega de relatórios e aprendizados transversais de negócio, indo muito além de métricas puramente táticas de mídia.

• Liderança de Time: Liderar e orientar o time de especialistas analíticos dedicados ao suporte e entregas da torre.

• Estudos e Insights de Categoria: Desenvolver estudos, análises de mercado e investigações profundas dedicadas às marcas da sua torre.

• Autonomia na Condução: Atuar com independência na gestão das rotinas, relacionamento com stakeholders e condução estratégica das pautas, com report ao Gerente de Research.

Requisitos e Ferramentas:

• Experiência Profissional: Vivência sólida em Data Strategy, Business Intelligence, Planejamento de Mídia/Dados ou inteligência de mercado em agências, consultorias ou anunciantes.

• Domínio de Métricas Diversas: Amplo conhecimento e facilidade para transitar por diferentes ecossistemas de indicadores, métricas de Mídia, Social, PR, CRM, E-commerce, Vendas, Receita e Negócio.

• Ferramentas de Mercado, Pesquisa e Listening: Conhecimento prático e navegação em ferramentas de inteligência de mercado e dados (ex.: TGI, ferramentas de Ad Intelligence/Monitoramento de Mídia, plataformas de Social Listening, etc.).

• Frameworks de Mensuração: Capacidade de desenhar planos de medição, definir KPIs integrados e metodologias para acompanhar a jornada do consumidor de ponta a ponta.

Diferenciais:

• Vivência direta com marcas dos segmentos de Beleza, Cosméticos, Perfumaria e/ou operações do varejo em datas sazonais .

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, Looker Studio ou Tableau).

• Experiência prévia com liderança ou coordenação de times analíticos.

title: Expert Audio Transcriber, Moroccan Arabic (Darija)
description:
ABOUT PERLE
Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.
Apply here:
THE ROLE
We are hiring expert Moroccan Arabic (Darija) transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.
You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.
DIALECT AND SCOPE
Moroccan Darija, one of the most distinct Arabic varieties, with substantial Tamazight (Berber), French, and Spanish lexical influence. Project audio reflects everyday Moroccan speech including frequent code-switching with French.
Primary speaker regions: Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Fes, Tangier, Agadir.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide

• Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music

• Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech

• Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions

• Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery

• Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

• Native fluency in Moroccan Darija with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Morocco

• Strong command of Modern Standard Arabic for orthographic decisions on Darija speech

• Working knowledge of French sufficient to transcribe French loanwords and code-switching

• Familiarity with regional Moroccan varieties and Tamazight-influenced vocabulary

• At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience

• Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure

• Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback

• Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace

• Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

• Background in North African linguistics, translation, journalism, or Arabic NLP

• Prior work on Darija speech datasets or Maghrebi Arabic annotation projects

• Knowledge of Tamazight or Spanish for additional cross-lingual audio segments

• Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems

• Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

• Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate

• Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround

• Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects

• Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team

• Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

title: Financial Compliance Manager
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Financial Compliance Manager, you will oversee financial reporting compliance for Vinted Group, covering accounting policy development, internal processes and procedures alignment, the application of IFRS and internal advisory on financial compliance and accounting topics. The position exists to ensure that financial operations adhere to internal policies and external regulation for both Group and standalone financial reporting, with particular focus on sound professional judgement, application of best industry practice, and the consistency and integrity of financial reporting. You will work extensively with external auditors to achieve that standard. This is an expert individual contributor role.

You will work daily with the Business Finance Control and Group Accounting teams, and closely interact with internal and external auditors. Beyond that, you will have regular touch points across Group Finance and the business unit finance teams, including internal controls, financial planning and analytics, and financial operations, ensuring financial reporting compliance advisory across different functions within Vinted.

In this position, you’ll 

• Develop, implement and oversee financial compliance and accounting policies tailored to the Vinted business model, and review them as regulation and practice change.

• Monitor regulatory and accounting standard developments, and implement the resulting adjustments to policies and procedures.

• Advise the Finance Control teams on complex IFRS compliance and accounting treatment questions. Depending on complexity, either write or review documentation analysing accounting treatment for specific business cases. 

• Contribute to the internal controls that safeguard the accuracy and integrity of financial reporting.

• Identify, assess and monitor financial compliance risks within Finance Control, and support the preparation of mitigation strategies and action plans.

• Design and deliver training on compliance requirements, accounting standards and internal policies for the Finance teams.

• Investigate potential compliance violations and discrepancies, and design corrective action that prevents recurrence.

• Collaborate with internal and external auditors to ensure comprehensive compliance coverage.

• Use finance systems and data analysis tools to strengthen compliance monitoring, reporting and analysis.

• Mentor colleagues across the Finance teams and spread compliance practice beyond your immediate area.

title: Nurse Practitioner - NY License (Full Time)
description:
Nurse Practitioner
Integrated Women’s Care (IWC) Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Compensation: $55 - $70 / hour, based on geographic location
Reports To: Nurse Practitioner Manager
Work Location: Remote - work must be completed within the United States
Schedule: Between 7:00 am - 7:00 pm, patient local timezone
You built your career caring for women at a time when the healthcare system largely ignored them. You know HRT, you understand the complexity of perimenopause, and you’ve spent years earning the clinical instincts it takes to actually get this right. Now you want to do it at scale - for more patients, with fewer barriers, and in a practice model that matches how you already think and work.
That’s what Midi is. A fully virtual, fast-paced clinical environment built specifically around women’s midlife health - and designed for NPs who are ready to practice at their best.
THE ROLE
You’ll carry a full patient panel, managing perimenopause, menopause, weight, sexual health, mood, and sleep - all virtually. This is ongoing, relationship-based care, which means your patients come back to you - visit after visit, over months and years. You’ll prescribe and independently manage HRT (estrogen, progesterone, testosterone), evaluate patients for pharmacologic weight management including GLP-1 therapies, and make autonomous clinical decisions every day.
It’s a high-volume environment. Documentation, follow-through, and productivity benchmarks are part of the job - and the NPs who thrive here don’t fight that reality, they’re built for it. If you’re the kind of clinician who runs efficient visits without sacrificing warmth, closes every loop without being reminded, and moves comfortably between patients and platforms, you’ll feel at home here.
WHO THRIVES HERE
Our most successful NPs tend to share a few things in common:

• They are genuinely passionate about women’s midlife health - this isn’t a stopover, it’s their calling

• They are fluent with technology - EHR, video, AI scribe tools, Slack, clinical decision support - and they adapt quickly when tools change

• They hold themselves to a high standard without needing to be managed toward it

• They can carry a full panel, hit productivity targets, and still make every patient feel like the only one

• They’ve practiced independently long enough to trust their own clinical judgment

• They believe that listening deeply and documenting accurately are both forms of excellent care

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Active board certification: FNP-C / FNP-BC or WHNP-BC

• 3+ years independently managing perimenopause and menopause patients

• 3+ years independently prescribing and titrating HRT

• 3+ years managing a continuous NP patient panel - building ongoing relationships and making autonomous clinical decisions over time

• 3+ years of synchronous telemedicine experience

• 1+ year evaluating and prescribing pharmacologic weight management therapies, including GLP-1 agonists

• Multiple active state licenses (DEA preferred)

• Preferred: certification in Menopause (MSCP) and/or Obesity Medicine

WHY MIDI

• A patient population that is engaged, informed, and deeply grateful for real care

• Full clinical autonomy within a supportive, protocol-driven framework

• Fully remote with scheduling between 7am-7pm patient local time

• Desirable benefits package

• Accredited training eligible for Continuing Education (CE)

• Clinician Professional Development Allowance

• Paid time off

• A team that takes women’s health as seriously as you do

WORKING ENVIRONMENT
This is a fully remote position requiring reliable high-speed internet access and the ability to work effectively in a virtual environment. The role involves prolonged computer use, including extended periods of sitting, video conferencing, and electronic documentation. To support patient access and business needs, occasional evening, weekend, or multi-time-zone coverage may be required.

Conveo is building AI powered consumer understanding infrastructure: the layer that lets the world's best consumer brands stay continuously connected to their consumers through AI-led video conversations. We work with some of the largest CPG, tech, and research organizations in the world, and we are scaling fast off the back of a strong Series A trajectory.

Our story is visual by nature. Real consumers, on camera, saying things that change decisions inside the world's biggest brands. The company that tells that story best on video wins the category.

This is a builder's seat. You own the entire content engine end to end: what we film, why we film it, and the quality bar it ships at. You lay the dirt roads others can run over: repeatable formats, production pipelines, and standards that let content scale without you touching every frame forever.

Expect the first stretch to be very hands-on. You will have budget to hire editors, freelancers, and crews, and you can edit at a high level yourself. In the early months, you often will.

Above all, this is a storytelling job at two altitudes. Every individual piece has to be exceptionally told on its own terms. And the formats, arcs, and throughlines across everything we ship have to add up to one coherent story that is unmistakably on brand.

You have owned or run a video studio, production company, or in-house video function, with the scars and systems to show for it

- You have directed

We are looking for an experienced, commercially aware, and regulatory-savvy compliance professional to join us as Head of Compliance and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).

Broader team management responsibilities will be added in due course for regulatory strategy, operational execution, and governance.

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better.

HubSpot's pricing and monetization strategy is evolving to support hybrid business models that combine usage-based credits, AI consumption, seat-based packaging, and enterprise pricing. As the Principal Technical Program Manager, Pricing & Monetization, you will lead the technical programs that make this transformation possible. You'll connect pricing strategy, technical implementation, and compliance to ensure that monetization decisions are executable, scalable, and aligned with HubSpot's long-term revenue strategy. Working across Pricing Strategy, Fintech Engineering, Finance, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, you'll influence executive decision-making while driving complex, multi-year programs that shape the future of HubSpot's monetization platform.

What You'll Do

• Lead the portfolio strategy and execution for HubSpot's hybrid monetization platform, including contracts, usage metering, billing, invoicing, and related systems.

• Partner with Fintech Engineering leadership to define program priorities, align technical roadmaps with pricing strategy, and drive execution across Metronome, UBB metering, and billing infrastructure.

• Ensure pricing initiatives are planned, sequenced, and implemented with appropriate SOX controls, audit readiness, and revenue recognition requirements.

• Lead complex, cross-functional programs supporting initiatives such as AI and agent monetization, HSOC seat packaging, usage-based billing, and credit infrastructure.

• Maintain portfolio-level visibility across pricing and monetization programs, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and sequencing decisions while communicating executive-ready updates.

• Serve as the primary bridge between Pricing Strategy and Engineering, ensuring pricing decisions are technically feasible, scalable, and operationally sustainable.

• Translate engineering constraints into strategic insights that improve pricing governance and reduce downstream technical or compliance debt.

• Develop scalable governance processes and enablement that improve proposal quality, increase decision velocity, and reduce off-process work across Product and Go-to-Market teams.

• Champion customer value by ensuring monetization strategies balance business objectives with transparent, customer-centric product experiences.

• Influence executive discussions through the Pricing Governance Board by providing clear recommendations, trade-offs, and implementation guidance.

• Leverage AI and automation to streamline governance workflows, improve operational efficiency, and increase focus on strategic decision-making.

• Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders across Pricing, Engineering, Finance, Product, and Go-to-Market organizations while mentoring Technical Program Managers and elevating program management practices across HubSpot.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

• Significant experience leading complex, enterprise-scale technical programs with multi-year scope and company-wide impact.

• Deep understanding of SaaS pricing, billing, and monetization systems, including usage-based billing, subscription models, credit systems, invoicing, and hybrid pricing models.

• Experience driving cross-functional governance and operating models that balance execution speed with operational rigor and compliance.

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and operate independently with VP- and executive-level stakeholders.

• Experience managing portfolios of highly interdependent technical programs across multiple organizations.

• Strong technical acumen with the ability to partner effectively with Engineering leadership and influence architectural decisions.

• Proven ability to align Product, Pricing, Engineering, Finance, and Go-to-Mar

title: Data Analytics Engineer - Corporate Data Analytics Group
description:
Internal Job Title: Data Analytics Engineer
Job Type: Permanent, Full-time
Location: Ottawa, Ontario
Work Model: Remote
Job Status: Existing Vacancy
Position Summary
The Data Analytics Engineer plays a critical role in preparing enterprise data to be AI-ready by designing rich semantic layers and business context that enable advanced analytics, self-service BI, and AI-powered decision-making. This role focuses on transforming curated data into trusted, governed, and reusable data products that can be safely consumed by business users, copilots, and machine learning models across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
Business Partnership & Domain Alignment

• Partner with business stakeholders to translate domain knowledge into structured analytical and semantic representations.
Semantic Modeling & Data Foundation

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise semantic models that represent business meaning, metrics, and relationships across data domains.

• Collaborate with data engineers to shape silver and gold datasets that support semantic clarity and downstream AI consumption.

• Build AI-ready data products by enriching datasets with business definitions, hierarchies, metadata, and contextual logic.

BI Development & Metric Standardization

• Develop and optimize Power BI semantic models, datasets, and metric layers to support BI, Copilot, and AI use cases.

• Create and manage standardized KPIs and calculations using DAX, ensuring consistency and reuse across analytics and AI workloads.

• Document business logic, data definitions, and metric context to support discoverability and AI-assisted querying.

Governance, Security & Trusted Data

• Implement data governance controls including row-level security (RLS), object-level security, sensitivity labels, and certified datasets.
Data Product Enablement & AI Integration

• Publish trusted semantic models and datasets to enable self-service and AI-assisted analytics at scale.

• Support integration of analytics models with AI and ML workflows, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) scenarios.

Performance Optimization & Reliability

• Monitor and optimize model performance, refresh reliability, and query efficiency.
Standards & Continuous Improvement

• Contribute to analytics and AI standards and best practices through the Data & AI Community of Practice.
Mandatory Requirements

• Legally eligible to work in Canada.

• Fluent in English (speak, read, write).

• Able to obtain (in a timely manner) and maintain Government of Canada Secret (Level II) security clearance.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

• Understanding of the following:

• Semantic modeling concepts including metrics, hierarchies, and dimensional modeling.

• Data governance principles and secure data access patterns.

• 8+ years of relevant professional experience, including:

• 3+ years of professional experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data modeling roles.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Media Experience
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help us build the next version of our media infrastructure. In this role, you will define the work on the technical components of how we ingest, process, store, and deliver video and audio content at Reddit . You will tackle complex technical challenges to support our media product strategy and deliver high-quality media experiences globally.
Key Responsibilities

• Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to execute on product and business strategy and build novel products and features that our users will love.

• Contribute to the full development cycle: technical design, development, test, experimentation, analysis, and launch. You’ll be reviewing code and design docs, giving feedback on product specs and mocks.

• Participate with a team of thoughtful, fast-moving, and motivated engineers. Contribute to standards that improve developer workflows, recommend best practices, and help mentor junior engineers on the team to grow their technical expertise.

• Move fast while balancing quality. We can’t afford extensive processes, and we also can’t afford show-stopping bugs. We need someone who can balance speed with quality while quickly building brand-new products.

• Collaborate with client engineers and platform engineers to improve performance of media across Reddit to serve better content globally.

Qualifications

• BS degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field of study or equivalent practical experience

• 3+ years of industry experience in large-scale distributed systems.

• 5+ years of hands-on, professional software development experience in one or more general purpose programming languages (Go, Python, Ruby, Java, C++)

• Experienced with GraphQL, REST, HTTP, gRPC, Thrift basics, and the ability to design and implement maintainable APIs

• Experienced with distributed caching layers, and distributed large scale data storage systems like Redis.

• Familiarity with image processing and delivery technologies such as image scaling, cropping, and image formats like progressive JPEG, WebP, etc.

• Familiarity with HTTP Live Streaming (HLS), MPEG-DASH, MP4, and other streaming protocols, as well as video compression standards (H.264, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1)

• Strong organizational skills, the ability to prioritize tasks and to deliver projects on schedule.

• Excellent communication skills. You collaborate effectively with teams in a fully remote environment and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences.

What Will Set You Apart

• Demonstrated curiosity and commitment to staying up-to-date with advancements in video compression technologies, including attending conferences, reading research papers, and engaging with the latest industry trends.

• Strong understanding of how to measure and improve video visual quality metrics (eg., VMAF, PSNR)

• Hands-on expertise with tools like FFMPEG, GPAC and similar media frameworks for processing, modifying, and manipulating media streams.

• Experienced with client-side technologies, familiarly with the client library around media (eg., AVFoundation, VideoToolbox, video prefetching)

• Familiar with background data fetching.

• Strong data analysis skills using SQL

Benefits:

• Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

title: Initial Closing Disclosure Analyst
description:
The Initial Closing Disclosure (ICD) Analyst plays a critical role in the mortgage loan process by preparing, reviewing, and verifying the accuracy of the Initial Closing Disclosures (ICD). This position ensures compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies, ensuring borrowers receive accurate and timely disclosures of loan terms and costs. The ICD Analyst collaborates with internal teams such as loan processors, underwriters, and closing officers to resolve discrepancies and ensure smooth and timely loan closings.
Key Responsibilities

Preparation of Initial Closing Disclosures:

• Generate and review Initial Closing Disclosure (ICD) documents for accuracy and completeness in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

• Ensure that the ICD is sent to the borrower at least three business days prior to closing, adhering to TRID (TILA-RESPA Integrated Disclosure) regulations.

Data Review and Verification:

• Review loan terms, fees, taxes, and other financial data to ensure they are accurately reflected in the ICD.

• Cross-check all loan documentation to ensure alignment with underwriting conditions and customer information.

• Identify and resolve any discrepancies in loan documentation prior to issuing the ICD.

Compliance and Regulatory Adherence:

• Stay up to date with federal and state mortgage regulations (including TRID) to ensure all disclosures meet legal standards.

• Maintain detailed records of all issued ICDs and monitor timelines to ensure compliance with the three-day disclosure rule.

Collaboration with Internal Teams:

• Work closely with loan officers, underwriters, processors, and closing coordinators to ensure all necessary data is collected and accurately reflected in the ICD.

• Communicate with the loan origination team to address any borrower questions or concerns regarding the closing disclosure.

Quality Assurance and Reporting:

• Conduct quality control checks on all ICDs before submission to ensure there are no errors or omissions.

• Report any issues or trends regarding ICD errors or compliance risks to management for further review.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).

• Analytical mindset with the ability to identify and solve problems quickly.

• Familiarity with loan documentation, including closing disclosures, loan estimates, and underwriting terms.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage workflow efficiently.

Benefits

• Above market salary

• HMO with free dependent

• Paid leave incentives

• Performance based Incentives

• Quarterly Company Events

• In-depth training for career growth

description:
HelloFresh is seeking a Senior Associate, Claims & Risk Management to join our team! In this role, you’ll support day-to-day operations across claims management, reporting, and insurance program administration. The position is primarily focused on our Workers’ Compensation program, with additional support for a smaller portfolio of Property, Subrogation (Recovery), and Commercial Auto claims as needed.

If you’re an experienced claims professional ready for a new challenge beyond managing a high-volume caseload, this is an opportunity to bring your claims expertise into a corporate risk environment. You’ll gain broader exposure across multiple areas of risk management while helping identify trends, improve claims outcomes, support risk mitigation, and contribute to the overall risk strategy of a growing organization.

This role is a great fit for someone looking to make a career move that offers greater variety, broader responsibility, and room to grow beyond traditional claims adjusting.

You will...

• Partner closely with HelloFresh’s claims TPA to support effective claims management, improve outcomes, and help control claim severity.

• Monitor active Workers’ Compensation claims throughout the claim lifecycle, including adjuster and site follow-ups, aging claims, outstanding action items, and next steps.

• Build, maintain, and validate claims dashboards and reports; analyze loss data to identify trends, emerging risks, and recurring root causes, and partner with internal stakeholders on action plans.

• Track Return-to-Work progress and compliance-related activities, including audit support and timely updates across systems.

• Support subrogation and recovery efforts by tracking opportunities, following up on outstanding items, and maintaining required documentation.

• Assist with escalated claims involving complex investigations, litigation, significant injuries, or other high-risk exposures.

• Partner with the internal Legal team and external defense counsel across multiple states to manage and support litigation matters, including claim strategy, documentation, and ongoing case coordination.

• Support insurance program renewals through exposure data collection, analysis, and preparation of supporting information.

• Review claim files and collaborate with TPAs on reserve adequacy, claim strategy, and recommended next steps.

• Partner cross-functionally with internal teams to gather documentation, resolve issues, and facilitate timely and effective claim handling.

• Participate in regular meetings with insurance carriers, brokers, and TPAs to monitor claims, address open issues, and support overall program execution.

• Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve reporting, and enhance claims workflows.

• Support additional claims, insurance, and risk management initiatives as needed.

At a minimum, you have...

• 3-4 years of workers’ compensation claims experience, either as a WC claims adjuster at a TPA/carrier or in a corporate risk management function managing a WC program directly

• Strong Excel and data skills; experience with RMIS platforms (Riskonnect or similar) and Power BI is a plus

• Familiarity with TPA workflows, loss run analysis, and claim lifecycle management

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple active claims simultaneously

• Ability to adapt to changing business needs, with a flexible approach to shifting priorities, processes, and responsibilities

• Proactive communicator who can work independently and flag issues without being prompted

• Bachelor’s degree preferred; will consider candidates with a high school diploma and qualifying experience

• ARM, AIC, CPCU, or other risk/insurance designations are a plus but not required

You’ll get…

description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DEPLOYMENTS TEAM

- Turn empty data halls into serving GPUs in weeks. Deployment owns everything between construction handover and customer-ready compute: racks, fabric, and validation at hundreds of megawatts per site.

- Stand up gigawatts a year, hundreds of megawatts at a time. Data halls go from construction handover to serving GPUs in weeks, across multiple sites at once.

- Deploy 10s to 100s of GWs with software, not headcount. Bring-up, validation, and handoff run on tooling the team builds, so the hundredth data hall deploys faster than the first instead of needing a hundred times the people.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own end-to-end delivery per site: from construction handover through customer-ready compute, every workstream converging on the live date.

- Run the delivery schedule integrating deployment, network turn-up, compute bring-up, and validation.

- Chair the site delivery rhythm: blockers surfaced daily, escalated same-day, closed fast.

Founded in 1996, Argos Multilingual is a global provider of technology-enabled language, AI and data solutions. We combine human expertise, technology and AI to help organisations communicate, operate and grow across markets. 

We work with some of the world’s most recognised companies, from global technology leaders and e-commerce innovators to major organisations in life sciences and manufacturing.

We are an international organisation with 400+ people across 42 countries. We continue to expand our capabilities in AI and data alongside our established language and localisation expertise, building on a strong foundation while embracing the opportunities created by new technology. 

About the role

The Engagement Manager is responsible for building, establishing, and leading the contributor engagement function that supports a global freelance community delivering AI data, annotation, evaluation, content moderation, data collection, and language services.

The Engagement Manager will operate as both a strategic and hands-on leader, partnering closely with the Sourcing team to support contributor acquisition, onboarding, deployment, activation, and retention activities. As the freelance workforce community scales, the Engagement Manager will design and implement the engagement operating model, establish community management processes, define workforce engagement strategies, and build a dedicated Engagement team.

Working closely with Sourcing, Project Management, Delivery, Quality, Operations, and Product teams, the Engagement Manager will ensure contributors remain engaged, project-ready, effectively deployed, and connected to the organisation throughout their lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will have experience managing contingent or freelance workforce communities, building new operational functions, and creating scalable engagement frameworks that support workforce growth, utilisation, and retention.

Responsibilities

Engagement Function Development & Operational Design

• Establish and scale the Engagement function, processes, and operating model.

• Design and implement the Engagement function strategy, operating model, and supporting processes.

• Define the contributor lifecycle framework, from onboarding through activation, deployment, engagement, retention, and reactivation.

• Build scalable engagement programmes capable of supporting a rapidly growing global workforce community.

• Partner closely with Sourcing leadership to establish clear ownership boundaries and handoff processes between workforce acquisition and workforce engagement.

• Create engagement playbooks, workflows, service standards, and operational procedures.

• Define workforce engagement KPIs, contributor health metrics, utilisation measures, and retention indicators.

• Evaluate and implement tools, systems, and automation that enhance community engagement and contributor communications.

• Develop the business case and organisational structure for future Engagement team growth.

• Establish best practices for contributor communications, community management, workforce deployment, and escalation management.

• Continuously assess operational effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement as the function matures.

Workforce Engagement & Community Management

• Own the ongoing engagement of the freelance contributor community throughout the contributor lifecycle.

• Develop and execute engagement strategies that increase workforce participation, responsiveness, and retention.

• Build contributor engagement programmes from the ground up, including communication frameworks, lifecycle campaigns, and community initiatives.

• Maintain regular communication with active and inactive community members through email campaigns, newsletters, surveys, and engagement initiatives.

• Foster a strong sense of community among contributors supporting AI data and technology programmes.

• Establish contributor segmentation strategies to support

title: Product Marketing Strategist
description:
Description
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Product Marketing Strategist to the Marketing team who will help us stay ahead of our competitors and stand out with industry analysts.
Why join Sprout's Marketing team?
At Sprout Social , we don’t just market products-we set the pace for how breakthrough brands connect with the world. As the social intelligence platform powering the future of customer connection, our Marketing team is the driving force behind turning that vision into reality. We lead with clarity and act with speed to drive market leadership, generate demand, and accelerate customer expansion, all in close partnership with core cross-functional stakeholders.
Here, you’ll have the freedom to test bold ideas, learn fast, and shape the future of the global brands we empower. •
Be our early warning system. Be the first person at Sprout Social to share updates on emerging platforms and new features from established providers.

•
Publish regular intelligence reports. Write clear, useful reports for stakeholders across research and development (R&D) and Product Marketing. Tell them what changed, why it matters and what we should do about it.

•
Build a network of sources. Gather intelligence from analyst reports, review sites, win-loss interviews, and conversations with Sales and CS teams.

•
Use AI to scale your work. Use AI tools to build core intelligence once, then systemize it across the company. Partner closely with our GTM Systems and Applied AI team in Revenue Operations to put competitive insight inside the tools Sales and CS use every day.

Analyst relations (about 30% of your time)

Manage our relationships with industry analysts. Coordinate briefings and inquiry calls with key analyst relations firms. Keep them up to date on Sprout Social 's products, including NewsWhip, Listening, and Influencer Marketing.

•
Support major analyst evaluations. Help prepare submissions, demos and references for influential industry reports. Make sure Sprout Social is represented accurately and well.

•
Leadership/Exec support: Work closely with leadership in developing presentations they can deliver to influential analysts.

•
Bring analyst insight back into Sprout Social . Capture what analysts say about our market and our competitors. Share it with Product, Marketing and leadership.

•
Keep the calendar and the record. Track analyst report cycles, deadlines and follow-up actions so nothing slips.

What you’ll bring

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Community Boost is seeking a Performance Marketing Manager who is equal parts client strategist, media buyer and technical executor in Google/Meta ads. In this role, you will be the primary strategic partner for a dedicated portfolio of small size nonprofit clients. This role reports to the Director of Client Services and is responsible for the holistic health of the client relationship-leading the conversation, designing the roadmap, and personally executing the media buying that brings that roadmap to life. This role is a REMOTE POSITION and can be anywhere in the US.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

•
Strategic Consulting: Act as the lead advisor for a portfolio of nonprofit partners. Identify growth opportunities, troubleshoot organizational challenges, and align digital tactics with long-term fundraising goals.

•
Client Relationship Management: Lead all client-facing communications for 15 clients, including monthly strategy sessions and performance deep-dives.

•
Full-Stack Channel Execution: Own the hands-on execution and optimization across major platforms including Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search, PMAX, Grant). Perform weekly account health checks to refine bidding, audiences, ad creative, and campaign structures to maximize ROAS and CPA targets.

•
Narrative Reporting: You know how to move beyond "vanity metrics." and be able to articulate the why behind performance trends to Marketing Directors and Nonprofit Boards.

•
Omnichannel Strategy & Attribution: Drive integrated strategies across multiple channels (Paid Search, Social, Programmatic). Utilize advanced attribution concepts (multi-touch, LTV, incrementality) to provide a holistic view using GA4 and Ninjacat to track how channels drive donor acquisition and long-term value.

•
Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Develop and implement a disciplined testing framework, including monthly hypotheses, recommended variants, implementation, and reporting on results to maximize on-page conversions.

•
Project Management: Maintaining project management using Asana and Basecamp, and ensuring all client deliverables are met on time without internal oversight.

Qualifications

•
Deep Channel Expertise (Required): Primary experience must be in Google Ads Grant and Meta Ads Manager, with a strong background in other paid media such as Programmatic (Display) and video (YouTube). You must be comfortable jumping between high-level cross-channel strategy and granular platform optimizations.

•
Agency Experience (Required): 3-5 years in a fast-paced agency environment, managing client relationships and significant media spend simultaneously.

•
Nonprofit Sector Knowledge: Experience working with nonprofits is highly preferred with an understanding of donor psychology, the "giving season," and nonprofit budget constraints.

Required Skills

•
Client Presentation Mastery: Proven track record of leading meetings and presenting complex strategies to senior-level stakeholders with confidence.

•
The Consultant Mindset: Proactive rather than reactive. You anticipate client needs and bring new ideas to the table before being asked.

•
Time Management: Consistently meets deadlines by organizing tasks, managing priorities, and avoiding last-minute scrambles. Demonstrates reliability in day-to-day execution.

•
Attention to Detail: Delivers polished, error-free work by catching inconsistencies and ensuring accuracy across all deliverables. Maintains high standards even under pressure.

•
Written Communication: Writes clearly and professionally, adapting tone and format to suit internal and client audiences. Avoids ambiguity and ensures messages are easy to understand.

•
Team Collaboration: Works well with others by sharing information, supporting teammates, and contributing to a positive team dynamic. Builds trust through dependability and openness.

•
Project Management: Plans and executes projects with clear timelines, milestones, and accountability. Keeps stakeholders info

title: Receptionist & Prior Authorization Specialist (Primary Care)
description:
We are seeking a proactive, highly organized Front Desk Receptionist & Prior Authorization Specialist to support a brand-new primary care practice launching this fall. Supporting a solo practitioner, you will serve as the operational backbone of the office-handling patient calls, managing scheduling, facilitating medication refill requests, and taking full ownership of insurance eligibility and diagnostic prior authorizations.
Because this is a solo medical practice, the ideal candidate is an independent self-starter who excels at multi-tasking and understands U.S. insurance workflows inside and out. Hands-on experience securing diagnostic prior authorizations (CTs, MRIs, specialty imaging, etc.) is an absolute requirement.

Schedule & Working Environment

•
Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)

•
Start Date: Practice Opening October 5th (Onboarding prior)

• Schedule (US Eastern Standard Time - EST):

•
Mon, Tue, Thu: 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM EST

•
Wednesday: 11:00 AM - 7:30 PM EST

•
Friday: 8:30 AM - 12:30 PM EST (Half-Day)

Top 3 Daily Tasks

•
Prior Authorizations & Insurance Verification: Secure prior authorizations for diagnostic testing (CT scans, MRIs, lab work) and verify active insurance coverage before patient visits.

•
Inbound Phone Operations & Scheduling: Answer incoming calls, handle appointment bookings, answer patient inquiries, and step in if patients need assistance with the automated intake system.

•
Medication Refill & Prescription Requests: Field incoming phone requests for medication refills, gather clinical details, and route them to the physician according to practice protocols.

Core Responsibilities

•
Prior Authorization Ownership (Non-Negotiable): Submit, track, and follow up on prior authorization requests for diagnostic imaging (MRIs, CTs, Ultrasounds) and medications with commercial and government payers.

•
Front Desk & Call Management: Manage high-touch inbound phone calls professionally, maintain practice scheduling, and address administrative patient inquiries.

•
Clinical Administrative Support: Receive and process medication refill calls; compile pharmacy details and chart notes for provider review.

•
Automated Intake Backup: Monitor the practice's automated patient check-in platform, assisting patients remotely when manual intervention is required.

•
Consult & Fax Management: Process, track, and follow up on outgoing consultation faxes, medical record requests, and specialist reports.

•
EMR & Platform Navigation: Utilize Alasia Health and Ambient AI to document patient communications, record details, and manage daily workflows.

Requirements
Required Qualifications

•
Prior Authorization Experience (NON-NEGOTIABLE): Demonstrated hands-on background obtaining diagnostic (CT, MRI) and medication prior authorizations directly from insurance companies.

•
Insurance Verification Expertise: Thorough knowledge of U.S. health insurance plans, co-pays, deductibles, and eligibility checking.

•
Healthcare Front Office Background: Minimum 2+ years of experience in medical reception, patient scheduling, or primary care front-desk administration.

•
Schedule Agreement: Ability to work the exact designated 40-hour shift structure (including Wednesday late shifts and half-day Fridays).

•
Communication & Demeanor: Fluent spoken and written English; warm, welcoming, and reassuring phone presence.

•
Remote Setup: A private, HIPAA-compliant home office with a reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a clear headset.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Solo Practitioner Support: Experience working in a boutique, primary care, or small solo-provider practice environment.

•
EMR/AI Tool Familiarity: Experience using Alasia Health , Ambient AI , or comparable modern EMR platforms.

Ideal Candidate Profile
You are an articulate, resourceful virtual assistant who thrives in a solo-provider setting. You treat prior authorizations as a high-priority mission, take pride in keeping patient schedules full and organized,

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

description:
Overview
Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.
Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.
Responsibilities
As a Medical Review Specialist V (Medical Reviewer V), you will review and analyze Medicare claims sampled by the Department of Justice, using associated medical records, to make payment determinations based on coverage, coding and utilization of services and practice guidelines. This is a casual/part time position.

• Conducts medical record claims review to determine correct coding, utilizing ICD-9-CM, ICD-10, CPT-4, and HCPCS Level II coding principles. Review medical documentation for medical necessity utilizing clinical knowledge and Center for Medicare Services (CMS) policies and guidelines, as well as other state and board regulations.

• Conducts in-depth claims analysis of suspected over-utilizers who are suspect of fraudulent billing practices, including analysis of Standard Claims Processing files to detect potential fraudulent or abusive billing practices or vulnerabilities in Medicare and/or Medicaid payment policies

• Completes summary report upon completion of the records review, summarizing claim determinations, clinical observations and other information requested by the DOJ based on the review of medical records

• Reviews and completes the required number of claims reviews in accordance to pre-established production standards for the project

• Produces and submits required reports according to established content and timeframes

• Communicates internally with all levels of the group

• Participates in Quality Assurance (QA) and IRR monitoring as requested

• Complies with departmental policies and procedures

• Complies with Medicare and DOJ guidelines and CMS directives, policies and regulations pertaining to integrity, fraud, overpayments, and the handling and disclosure of information

• Attends departmental and required education and training programsReviews information contained in Standard Claims Processing System to determine provider billing patterns and to detect potentially fraudulent or abusive billing practices or vulnerabilities in Medicare payment policies

• Utilizes the Medicare/Medicaid guidelines for coverage determinations

• Performs in-depth research and investigation using the Internet and other tools, including data analysis tools

• Maintains chain of custody on all documents, follows all confidentiality and security guidelines and completes assignments in a manner that meets or exceeds the contract quality assurance goals

Qualifications
Requirements:

• Registered Nurse (RN) (Bachelors, Associate’s degree or diploma-based)

• Current licensure as a Registered Nurse in one or more of the 50 states or D.C.

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Organization and time management skills

• Knowledge of and ability to use Microsoft Excel and word, Adobe PDFs and various internet applications

• At least 10 years of clinical experience

• Minimum seven (7) years claims knowledge either from billing, reviewing, or processing.

• Must have no adverse actions pending or taken against him/her by any State or Federal licensing board or program and must have no conflict of interest (COI)

ABOUT AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video https://youtu.be/gTPDn5XpeJg to explore what makes us unique.

YOU WILL:

- Review smaller vendor contracts: check them against our standard criteria, flag anything that needs a closer look from our Legal Counsels, and take the routine cases through to approval yourself

- Bring structure to our contract landscape: classify vendors into our vendor categories, build a clean filing logic, and make sure every agreement ends up where it belongs instead of in someone's inbox

- Support our data protection work in close collaboration with our Legal Counsel Privacy & IT: reviewing DPAs and vendor privacy terms, keeping our records of processing activities up to date, and flagging where personal data is involved

- Draft and manage low-level partnership agreements with student associations, from first draft to signature

- Support the team on civil law and IP topics, from trademark and copyright questions to content usage

- An interest in data protection - you don't need to be a GDPR expert, but you should be the kind of person who notices when something touches personal data and asks about it

- First exposure to or genuine interest in civil law and IP law, whether from your studies or a previous role

- A structured, reliable way of working: the kind of person who finishes the filing, not just the interesting part of the task

- Clear, precise writing - you'll draft and comment on contracts that other AMBOSSians rely on

YOU ENJOY:

- You work independently and with ambition, but in close collaboration with a team of three seniors - you don't need someone checking in on you to make progress

- You pick things up hands-on and want to keep growing beyond the tasks you already know

- You have good judgement about what you can decide yourself and what needs the owner of a senior team member and you'd rather ask once too often than once too little

- You're curious about how legal work connects to the commercial side of a business, and you want to see contracts in their real context rather than only in a seminar

title: 3PL Operations Manager

iFIT ’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

The 3PL Manager is responsible for the day-to-day oversight and performance management of iFIT 's North American third-party logistics partners.
